entities.summary: Dobu Island, is an extinct volcano, part of D'Entrecasteaux Islands in Papua New Guinea (PNG). It is located in Dawson Strait, south of Fergusson Island and north of Normanby Island. It is currently administered by Dobu Rural LLG. The people speak the Dobu language, which is shared with the neighbouring islands in the D'Entrecasteaux group. The island has a long history of trading with nearby islands and with the Trobriand Islands to the north and Milne Bay to the south as part of the kula ring ceremonial exchange system.
